kept.spine: The Guild Council is well thought of at Spitzplatz, and the good opinion is spent on decisions the town would otherwise refuse it.
The Guild Council's standing rests on the town's prosperity, and nothing else in the town would hold it up.
A buyer off the road at Spitzplatz deals with one name, gets one answer, and finds the same answer standing the next season.
The books of several houses here are in perfect order, and that order is the thing being bought.
The town has no one word for how it is governed, and the hall does not have one either.

kept.poolKey: governing body name: a SLOT, never a baked noun
kept.spine: The hall is given its full title in the market square and a shorter name everywhere else, and both names are exact.
The Guild Council holds its seat because nothing else in the town outweighs it, and the weighing is done again every season.

kept.poolKey: legitimacyHold: public backing hardens the hold
kept.spine: Those who would move on the Guild Council do not, because moving on a seat the town stands behind costs more than the seat is worth.
